```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(terra)
library(leaflet)

# 1. Load your two GeoTIFF files (Timepoint 1 and Timepoint 2)
# Replace with actual file paths relative to your .qmd file
tif_t1 <- rast("data/CFN_CA-1_2023-04-13_web.tif")
tif_t2 <- rast("data/CFN_CA-1_2024-04-12_web.tif")

# 2. Reproject to WGS84 for Leaflet
tif_t1_wgs84 <- project(tif_t1, "EPSG:4326")
tif_t2_wgs84 <- project(tif_t2, "EPSG:4326")

# 3. Build Map using standard addRasterImage
leaflet(width = "100%", height = "800px") %>%
  addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  
  addRasterImage(
    tif_t1_wgs84,
    opacity = 0.8,
    group = "Timepoint 1"
  ) %>%
  
  addRasterImage(
    tif_t2_wgs84,
    opacity = 0.8,
    group = "Timepoint 2"
  ) %>%
  
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("Timepoint 1", "Timepoint 2"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
